faq.q: What can go on the back of the card?
faq.a: The back has four modes: Logo + Company, a QR code, a Services list (comma or newline separated, up to six shown), or a Tagline. The QR code can encode either your website URL or a full vCard contact (name, title, company, phone, email, website, address) so a scan saves your details. The QR uses a UTF-8 encoder, so Hindi text or the rupee sign scan correctly.

faq.q: Which card sizes and export formats are available?
faq.a: Four sizes: US/Intl 3.5×2 in, European 85×55 mm, Square 55×55 mm and Slim 85×40 mm. You can export the front or back as PNG, both as a ZIP, copy the current side to the clipboard, or generate a PDF. The single-card PDF is set to the card's real physical dimensions, and there's an A4 sheet PDF that tiles multiple cards per page with cut marks.

faq.q: Can I print a full sheet to cut at home?
faq.a: Yes. The A4 Sheet (cut marks) button lays out as many cards as fit on an A4 page at the card's physical size, with faint corner cut marks at each card, and tells you how many cards per page. There's also a Print option that opens front and back in a print window, and bleed/safe-area guides you can toggle on the preview.

faq.q: Will my design be saved if I close the tab?
faq.a: Use Save Card Data to store all your text fields, template, size, colour, font and back settings in this browser, and Load Saved Data to bring them back. The logo image itself isn't saved — you re-upload it. There are 8 templates (Minimal, Modern Gradient, Corporate, Creative Bold, Elegant Serif, Tech Dark, Medical Clean, Consultant) and 8 palette presets.
